text_block_list.text:
One day, Stay Gold suggested going camping 
in the mountains, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm? We haven't made any plans yet.
choice_data_list: I had a feeling that was the case...

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, having heard it was a camping 
trip, I rushed out to buy camping gear, 
groceries, and even a first-aid kit, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. There's no problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that's a poisonous mushroom. Just 
because bugs are eating it doesn't mean 
it's safe.

Since it was a campsite where you could go 
mushroom picking, I gathered mushrooms 
alongside her. ...Before we knew it, we 
had wandered deep into the mountains.
choice_data_list:
I wonder if we can make it back to the 
campsite properly.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry. I've got a compass on my 
clothes, you see.
choice_data_list: (A compass... on her racing outfit...?)

text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I also wondered why 
she was wearing her racing silks on a trip 
in the first place, but—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Hm? What's that? Is there a river nearby?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, we're allowed to fish 
here. Since we're here, why not give it a 
shot? If we catch any river fish, it'll 
make a fine feast.

That said, I have no tools. No fishing 
gear, and no harpoon either.
choice_data_list: How do you catch the fish?
How do you catch the fish?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that, well—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Make a fishing rod.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
My racing outfit comes equipped with a 
knife and a lantern. I can illuminate my 
hands and carve the wood.
choice_data_list:
Even though it's a racing outfit, why are 
there so many props?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's for moments like this. Now 
then—shall we begin?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, took the bait, did ya? That's a 
nice bite.
choice_data_list: Oh, you did it!
Oh, you did it!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

While I was busy looking at her catch— I 
felt a sudden, forceful tug on my line.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey, your line is tugging too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This one's huge! Quite a high-grade catch.
choice_data_list: !... Whoa, heavy!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hang in there! We're having a feast 
today.

Mustering all my strength, I pulled up the 
fishing rod with force. Along with a 
splash of water, a huge fish appeared 
before my eyes.
choice_data_list: I caught one—!!

text_block_list.text:
"I cook the food gathered today. Tonight's 
meal is foil-baked mushrooms and fish."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it was a good journey today, too.

Heading out to gather mushrooms, catching 
fish, and then cooking— the 
multifunctionality of this racing attire 
truly shone today.
choice_data_list:
That racing outfit comes in handy outside 
of races too, huh?

That racing outfit comes in handy outside 
of races too, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Told you, right? There's nothing to worry 
about. —Because I have my racing 
Racewear."
choice_data_list:
Yeah, the functionality really is 
outstanding.

Yeah, the functionality really is 
outstanding, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, let's see. Rather than 
functionality...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's to enjoy the journey even more. 
That's what this outfit is for.

"Racewear is a tool for enjoying the 
journey. Yet she wears it even in races."
choice_data_list: Then how about wearing that for the race?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer. What difference do you 
think there is between traveling and 
racing?"

Caught off guard by her sudden question, I 
pause what I'm doing to think.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Travel is for enjoyment, while races are 
serious business... or something like 
that?
choice_data_list: Yeah. That might be it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I bet. But... yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Trips like this, and races too... They're 
all part of one long journey, don't you 
think?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit is just meant for enjoying 
such a long journey. Nothing more than 
that."

"Enjoying the journey"—to understand her, 
I felt that I needed to further hone my 
own sensibilities.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try imitating you for once.
Maybe I'll try imitating you for once.
I want my own survival outfit.

text_block_list.text:
"Enjoying the journey"—to understand her, 
I felt that I needed to further hone my 
own sensibilities.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll try imitating you for once.
Maybe I'll try imitating you for once.
I want my own survival outfit.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Imitation...? There's no need for that. 
It's boring if we're just the same, isn't 
it?
choice_data_list: Wait, but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Having you around brings back memories, 
too. Like the first time I went camping in 
the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: So just enjoy yourself as you are. Right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, wanna go buy some then?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what about that one? It's great! It's 
got dozens of pockets!

Its functionality is undeniable. It easily 
fits a smartphone, a folding umbrella, and 
even a power bank.
choice_data_list:
Those clothes look like they'd make any 
journey fun.

Those clothes look like they'd make any 
journey fun.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're starting to get it. The most 
important thing is whether you can have 
fun... That's all there is to it.
